# AI 手记 / AI Notes

> 一个 16 年互联网人在 AI 时代亲手做事的记录。 Notes from 16 years in the internet industry, on building things by hand in the AI era. 作者 / Author: Leen Ma，CC BY 4.0。

- 系列首页 / Series home: https://leenlbma.github.io/ai-notes/ · https://leenlbma.github.io/ai-notes/en/

## 文章（中文）

- [01 · 仍然是一个亲手创造东西的人](https://leenlbma.github.io/ai-notes/posts/01-still-building-by-hand/): 一个 16 年互联网人的 2026 AI 手记：创造的成本、Demo 与交付、个人与组织效率、经验与人才，以及自己究竟想做什么。

## Posts (English)

- [01 · Still Someone Who Builds Things by Hand](https://leenlbma.github.io/ai-notes/posts/01-still-building-by-hand/en/): Notes on AI in 2026 from 16 years in the internet industry: the cost of creating, demos vs. delivery, individual vs. organizational speed, experience and talent, and what I really want to do.
